results.title: Hong Kong telecom company agrees to halt U.S. operations under pressure - CNBC
results.snippet: HKT, a leading Hong Kong telecom carrier and subsidiary of PCCW Ltd, on Friday agreed to halt its operations in the United States under pressure from the Federal Communications Commission. The FCC in October 2025 said it was moving to revoke the authority of HKT to operate in the United States, citing national security concerns and its affiliation with China Unicom, which is a shareholder in PCCW.

results.title: FCC seeks feedback on carrier D2D interference concerns - Light Reading
results.snippet: Amid a plan to open nearly 500MHz of spectrum for direct-to-device (D2D), the FCC is seeking comments on mobile operators' concerns that operating D2D in certain bands will cripple the performance of their 5G networks. It will consider warnings raised by AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon that operating D2D services in two heavily used 5G bands – 2.5GHz and 3.45GHz – will cripple 5G network performance. *
